theses.thesis: Overweight AI Compute & Optics relative to the CSI 300, conditional on sustained trend health (Hurst > 0.7, breadth > 0.7) and no escalation in geopolitical risk triggering a broad A‑share selloff. The theme occupies the number‑one rank with wide margin, broad participation (breadth 0.82), robust trend structure (durability 0.79, Hurst ‘trend’), and no crowding.
